**Babyface Brows | Park Slope, Brooklyn**  
**Part-Time | 15–25 hours/week | $20–$24/hour**

**IMPORTANT: Please apply through this online posting only. We ask that applicants do not call or come into the studio regarding this opportunity. Applications submitted by phone or in person will not be considered.** If we see a potential fit, our team will reach out directly.

About the Studio

Babyface Brows is a specialty brow and lash studio located in Park Slope, Brooklyn, steps from Barclays Center. Our focus is simple: expert brows, beautiful lashes, and an experience that keeps clients coming back.

We're looking for someone creative and driven to help tell our brand's story, create engaging social content, and strengthen our online presence.

The Opportunity

In this position, you'll work alongside management to develop and produce content for Babyface across Instagram, TikTok, and other social platforms.

You'll be involved in the creative process from coming up with ideas and planning shoots to filming, editing, and publishing. As you gain experience with the brand, you'll have the opportunity to take on more independence and contribute to additional areas of marketing.

Content Experience Is Required

**You must have experience creating and publishing content.** This doesn't have to come from a formal job. Personal social media, freelance projects, school assignments, or content you've created for a business are all relevant. What matters most is being able to show us what you've made and how you approach content creation.

Responsibilities

**Social Media & Content Production**

You'll help develop a variety of content for our social channels, such as:

* Before-and-after photos and transformations
* Informative graphics and educational carousels
* Reels, TikToks, skits, trends, and original video concepts
* Engaging stories and community-focused posts
* Behind-the-scenes content featuring our studio and team
* Other creative ideas that align with the Babyface brand

Other responsibilities include:

* Finding inspiration, researching trends, and pitching content ideas
* Organizing filming sessions with clients and artists
* Capturing services, results, and everyday studio activity
* Directing people during filming and helping them feel at ease
* Editing photos and videos with CapCut, Canva, or similar platforms
* Writing, preparing, and scheduling social media posts
* Helping maintain a steady flow of fresh, on-brand content

What You'll Work Toward

You'll begin by collaborating with management on content planning and production, with an emphasis on posting more consistently and improving the quality and creativity of what we share.

As you become familiar with our brand and audience, we want you to gradually own more of the process, including the content calendar, shoot planning, production, publishing, and performance review.

Ultimately, we're looking for someone who can take an idea and carry it through to a finished piece of content with increasing independence.

Room to Expand Into Marketing
